description: The N-Series Thin Client enables multiple users to utilize a single computer’s resources simultaneously, while still giving each person a full PC experience. The N-Series Thin Client doesn’t have any moving components and relies entirely on the central computer (host) for all processing and data storage. Because of this, it eliminates the need for installing drivers, managing updates, or paying for operating system licenses. This device is energy-efficient, resistant to tampering, and doesn’t store any data on-site, making it a secure and reliable option for various settings. This is not a stand alone computer. This device will work after connecting to a server/PC over RDP Protocol. Product colour might slightly vary due to photographic lighting sources or your monitor settings
